description: TravelSwitch helps users search and compare flights, hotels, and holiday packages using natural language inside ChatGPT. Users can find travel options, compare prices, explore itineraries, review hotel details, and continue booking on TravelSwitch when ready. The plugin retrieves live travel availability and pricing without making bookings or modifying reservations

defaultPrompt: Find the cheapest non-stop flight from Mumbai to Dubai departing next Friday.
show me roundtrip flights from Mumbai to dubai.
show me hotels in London for 5 days.
